AuthorizationResourceScope.description_en:
The authorization resource scope. Valid values:
global: All resources under the project.
custom: Specified resources within the project scope
AuthorizationResourceScope.description_zh:
授权资源范围。取值可选范围：
global：项目下全局资源
custom：指定项目范围下的资源

AuthorizationRuleCreationType.description_en:
The creation type of the authorization rule. Valid values:
system_init: Created by the system.
user_custom: Created by the user
AuthorizationRuleCreationType.description_zh:
授权规则的创建类型。取值可选范围：
system_init：系统创建
user_custom：用户创建

AuthorizationRuleScenarioLabel.description_en:
The scenario label of the authorization rule. Valid values:
privileged_cloud_account: Privileged cloud account scenario.
asset: Asset scenario
AuthorizationRuleScenarioLabel.description_zh:
授权规则场景标签，枚举值：
privileged_cloud_account（特权云账号场景）
asset（资产场景）

AuthorizationRuleSubjectId.description_en: The subject ID associated with the authorization rule

AuthorizationRuleSubjectScope.description_en:
The subject scope of the authorization rule. Valid values:
shared: Shared type, which supports all subjects, including accounts and applications.
exclusive: Exclusive type
AuthorizationRuleSubjectScope.description_zh:
授权规则主体范围，取值可选范围：
shared：共享型，即支持所有主体，包括账户、应用
exclusive：专属类型

AuthorizationRuleSubjectType.description_en:
The subject type associated with the authorization rule. This parameter is valid only when the authorization rule subject scope is exclusive. Valid values:
application: Application.
user: Account
AuthorizationRuleSubjectType.description_zh:
授权规则关联的主体类型，在授权规则主体范围为exclusive（专属类型）时有效，取值可选范围：
application：应用
user：账户

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
CreateTime.title_en: 创建时间, 毫秒时间
CreateTime.title_zh: 创建时间, 毫秒时间

Description.description_en: The description of the authorization rule

ProjectId.description_en: The project ID associated with the authorization rule
ProjectId.title_en: 授权规则关联的项目标识
ProjectId.title_zh: 授权规则关联的项目标识

Status.description_en:
The authorization rule status. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
Status.description_zh:
授权规则状态。取值可选范围：
enabled：启用
disabled：禁用

UpdateTime.description_en: The last update time, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 最近一次更新时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒
UpdateTime.title_en: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间
UpdateTime.title_zh: 最近一次更新时间, 毫秒时间
